title: ArtibotLease
description: Claim/Lease/Heartbeat record for a task owner or a mission controller (design ARTIBOT-5.0-DESIGN.md §7.2 Addendum §9). Four fields are canonical and required: owner, acquired_at, expires_at, heartbeat_at. Expiry is a derived judgement (now > expires_at => reclaimable) made by the Mission Controller, never a stored boolean. Prior art is lib/git/landing-lock.js (30-min TTL, PID-death + record-age staleness, O_EXCL reclaim); this schema adds the renew/heartbeat field that module lacks. NOTE two deliberate deviations from that prior art, both resolved in favour of the design text and state.yaml: field names are snake_case here vs camelCase there (acquiredAt/sessionId), and timestamps are ISO-8601 strings here vs epoch-millisecond numbers there (landing-lock.js sets acquiredAt: now()). A StateStore adapter must convert in both directions.

owner.description: Stable identifier of the holder: a worker/agent id for a task lease, or a session id for a mission controller lease.

acquired_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the lease was taken. Corresponds to landing-lock.js record.acquiredAt (epoch ms there).

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 instant after which the lease is reclaimable. Prior art default TTL is 30 minutes (landing-lock.js DEFAULT_STALE_MS).

heartbeat_at.description: ISO-8601 instant of the last renew. This is the field landing-lock.js has no equivalent of; renew is the only addition the design makes to that prior art.

token.description: Optional release guard carried over from landing-lock.js: release only when the stored token matches, so an evicted holder's late release cannot remove a reclaimed lease.

pid.description: Optional. Holder process id, used with host for the PID-death staleness axis (landing-lock.js defaultIsPidAlive).

host.description: Optional. Holder hostname. PID-death staleness is only valid when host matches the observer.

session_id.description: Optional. Claude Code session that holds the lease. Required in practice for missions.<M>.controller, where the leader session is the controller.
